verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own pipeline runs unattended in the background. Functions filter, transform and enrich every event before delivery, with Fetch, warehouse and persistent-storage APIs. Connector syncs run as Kubernetes CronJobs, a dead-letter reprocessing worker replays failed events, and Profile Builder generates profiles automatically. These are fixed data-pipeline automations rather than general user-defined or agentic background tasks; the MCP server lets an external agent configure the pipeline, but the agent itself runs outside Jitsu. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable scheduling/triggers for arbitrary automations, Jitsu-hosted autonomous agent runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
